morbi.headline: Morbi cluster shows premium-led recovery amidst export volume contraction and fraud risks.
what_changed: Varmora Granito reported H1 profit surge driven by premium tile margins, indicating sector recovery for larger players.
Indian ceramic tile exports experienced a steep 46% volume drop during April-July 2026 with a weak FY27 outlook.
A Morbi tile manufacturer faced a credit fraud incident involving a Mumbai buyer defaulting on Rs 44.74 lakh.
stress_signals: Export volume drop of 46% between April and Jul 2026 threatens export-reliant MSMEs [434975bd08e0].
Liquidity and counterparty risk highlighted by a Rs 44.74 lakh credit fraud involving a vanished buyer [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito financial results and 498% H1 profit jump point to recovery driven by premium tiles [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Whether recovery indicators extend from large branded players to smaller MSME vitrified and wall tile producers.
Export volume trends and overseas demand recovery for the remainder of FY27.
Counterparty credit checks, receivables management, and buyer verification protocols for outstation orders.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe loom shutdowns, power deficits, and persistent embroidery labour unrest.
what_changed: A 50% spike in raw material costs has led to a planned month-long loom shutdown impacting 75,000 workers.
Embroidery segment disruption escalated into a three-month labour impasse with over 80 worker detentions and planned stir intensifications.
Textile units experienced acute eight-hour power cuts, while wholesale markets cut Diwali lighting from 20 to 5 days due to a power crisis.
Textile manufacturers began diversifying into defence technical fabrics for the Indian Army alongside traditional sarees.
stress_signals: 50% raw material cost spike prompts month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Three-month labour dispute in the embroidery sector sparks protests over wages/holidays, 80 detentions, and plans to intensify the stir [8a31a5a2c20c, 7697e96a190e, 442c4ff911f8, e7921383cbb7].
Operational disruption from 8-hour power cuts and wholesale markets curtailing Diwali illumination to 5 days amid power shortages [167f80ff6cdc, c1de5b731833].
Diamond exports recorded a 7% drop in polished shipments, with reported labour charge defaults [975918f112f3, 698c779932f2].
improvement_signals: GST Council approved Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and curtailed highway inspections for textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Units commenced production and diversification into defence technical fabrics for the Indian Army [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
ICA-GemLab to open its first Indian laboratory in Surat for diamond and gemstone testing [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Terms, incentives, and release timeline of the upcoming new textile policy expected within three months.
Embroidery unit debt-servicing delays and bank account turnover during the prolonged job-work standstill.
Loom inventory levels and borrower working capital drawdowns following the 30-day shutdown.
